Code 3 wording differs between sources (questionnaire '(NO LEER) Ni lo uno no lo otro' [sic] under P.43/45/46 and '...ni lo otro' under P.44; label 'Ni uno ni lo otro') but code 3 is not in the live table, so nothing shipped depends on it. FILTER, checked against the data: the questionnaire prints 'ENTREVISTADOR/A: HACER PREGUNTAS 42 A 46 SÓLO A PERSONAS DE AMBOS SEXOS DE 29 AÑOS O MÁS' before P.42 (respondents 16-28 answered P.34-41 instead and were routed to P.47). In DA2998, P43-P46 are coded 0 'No procede' for exactly the 464 records aged 16-28 and non-zero for all 2015 records aged 29+ (0 violations on every item). The questions are NOT filtered on having children: P.43/P.45 are explicitly hypothetical for respondents without daughters/sons ('si no tiene hijas, en el supuesto de que las tuviera').
